barCreateHint: You can set permissions and members after creating it

noPermissionEditHint: This account cannot edit role permissions. View only.
menuSaveHint: Menu switches edit the same permissions as the Permissions tab. Changes are saved together at the bottom.
membersSearch: Search member name, account or email
derivedMembersHint: Store manager members follow the stores marked "Manage". They cannot be added or removed here.
